content.text: Let me scrutinize the F3_Z01 sensor for a possible fault (flatlined values, data gaps) versus a smooth thermal signal, and compare its hourly profile.

The F3_Z01 (Core_mid) temperature signal shows:
- Full-year coverage (8760/8760 hours, no gaps)
- Clean diurnal cycle consistent with all other zones
- No flatline (longest run of identical values = 10 hours, comparable to peer zones' 11)
- Physically plausible range (21.6–26.7 °C)
- Seasonal pattern that matches HVAC setpoints (~25 °C cooling SP)
- Persistent upward shift relative to Core_bottom/Core_top and Perimeter zones starting Aug–Sep 2018, while all zones still behave physically

None of the classic sensor-fault signatures (stuck value, flatline, out-of-range excursion, gap, uncorrelated drift) are present. The signal remains physically consistent — a real thermal differential in one zone, consistent with a local load change.
